title: Not much stretch, specific to a size
text: Not much stretch, specific to a size. It doesn't stretch as advertised, and it doesn't fit snuggly nor aesthetically onto the chair. The thickness of the cover was great, but overall did not work for what I needed. One good point to mention is that it is easy to clean if spills get onto it. However, overall purpose and quality of the product did not meet expectations and I would not recommend to others.
